table.retrieve:
SELECT Accounts.Name,
			Accounts.AliasName,
			Glheader.vochcatcode,   
         GLDetail.Debit,   
         GLDetail.Credit,   
         GLDetail.ChkNo,   
         GLDetail.Remarks,   
			Glheader.Posted,
         Glheader.Date,   
         Glheader.Remarks,   
         VocherCategory.Name,   
         Users.UserName,   
         Glheader.GLVochCode,
			Glheader.VoucherCode,
			GlDetail.Balance,
			CreditorDebit = Case GLDetail.Debit When 0 Then 'C' Else 'D' End,
			gldetail.glrowid,
			InvoiceCode=GLDetail.InvoiceCode,
			InvoiceBased=VocherCategory.InvoiceBased
    FROM GLDetail,   
         Glheader,   
         Accounts,   
         VocherCategory,   
         Users  
   WHERE ( Glheader.GLVochCode = GLDetail.GLVochCode ) and  
         ( Accounts.AccCode = GLDetail.AccCode ) and  
         ( VocherCategory.VochCatCode = Glheader.VochCatCode ) and  
         ( Users.UserCode = Glheader.salesmancode ) and  
         ( Glheader.GLVochCode = :ar_code )

objects.name: gldetail_chkno_t
objects.visible: 1	if( sum( if( ISNULL( gldetail_chkno), 0, 1) for all) > 0 , 1,0 )

objects.expression: if( balance +  gldetail_debit - gldetail_credit > 0, 'DR', if( balance +  gldetail_debit - gldetail_credit < 0, 'CR', ''))
